conversionToolchain.textureResampling: Pillow Lanczos max512px; preserve alpha when present

changes: Composed genuine original USD meshes and visual materials; no proxy or substitute modeling.
Preserved all source geometry polygons, authored normal/UV data, subset-material bindings, material constants and texture transforms.
Converted Z-up to glTF Y-up; retained meter scale; centered horizontal extents and grounded minimum height to zero.
Triangulated polygons and generated tangent bases. No decimation; glTF triangle counts exactly match sum(source face vertex count - 2).
Merged static meshes and deduplicated identical materials for fewer draw calls without changing shape or face count.
Resized original PBR images to maximum512px and embedded all image data in GLB. Original geometry detail was not reduced.
Converted PreviewSurface to glTF metallic/roughness. For authored UsdUVTexture nodes with no file, applied source fallback (0,0,0,1), not a fabricated texture.
Generated deterministic gzip copies; decompression byte-for-byte verified against each source GLB.
Dropped USD physics/semantic/runtime representations from browser visual assets.
limitations: Visual GLBs do not preserve USDPhysics, PhysX, MuJoCo or Newton runtime variants, mass/friction/collision/semantic/non-visual sensor schemas.
No real-time process telemetry, robot kinematics/control, load capacity, physical behavior, safety, collision, or FE result is supplied by these assets.
Original SimReady package metadata is retained as provenance, not certification of converted GLBs.
These are full-detail visual meshes. Use a bounded number of clones; share geometry/materials and measure scene render performance.
The tool cart is a human-pushed equipment cart, NOT an AGV. The packaging bench is a packaging workstation, NOT an automated assembly robot.
The roller conveyor is a modular single-end-supported segment intended for scene composition. Its loaded deck surface is about0.7693m; tallest posts are1.1663m.
MDL runtime standard/NVIDIA core-definition modules are not included in GLB and not needed; PreviewSurface was the conversion source.
Preview render illumination differs from the NVIDIA thumbnail renderer.
